name: Vikunja
tagline: A to-do and project app light enough for the smallest server
description: A task manager for individuals and small teams: projects with list, board, table and Gantt views, shared with people or teams, with reminders, labels, saved filters and calendar access over CalDAV. It runs as a single program.
backing: Developed mainly by its founder, funded by the hosted service and sponsors

maturity.rationale: Developed steadily for years and pleasant to run, but it rests largely on one maintainer and is aimed at tasks rather than at large projects.

selfHosting.summary: One binary or one container, with SQLite for a household or PostgreSQL for a team. Put it behind a reverse proxy with TLS, set up outgoing mail for reminders, and back up the database and attachments.

managedHosting.label: Vikunja Cloud
managedHosting.note: Run by the developer; paid plans

strengths: Very light: a single program that runs on the smallest server
List, board, table and Gantt views of the same tasks
Sign-in with OpenID Connect and calendar access over CalDAV are built in
Importers for Trello, Todoist, TickTick and Microsoft To Do
weaknesses: A task manager, not a full project suite: no sprints, time tracking or custom workflows
No importer for Jira or Asana

featureNotes.task-app-import: Trello, Todoist, TickTick and Microsoft To Do; not Asana
featureNotes.mobile-apps: There is an official app; how complete it is was not checked
